#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

base_url="https://10.70.0.1"
username="${UNIFI_USERNAME}"
password="${UNIFI_PASSWORD}"

cert_pem="$(cat /certs/tls.crt | awk '{printf "%s\\n", $0}')"
key_pem="$(cat /certs/tls.key | awk '{printf "%s\\n", $0}')"

date="$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M)"

token=""
csrf_token=""

fatal() {
  local msg="${1}"
  echo "[FATAL] ${msg}"
  exit 1
}

login() {
  resp="$(curl -k -X POST "${base_url}/api/auth/login" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d "{\"username\":\"${username}\",\"password\":\"${password}\"}" \
    -i)"

  token="$(echo "${resp}" | grep -i 'set-cookie: TOKEN=' | awk -F= '{print $2}' | awk -F';' '{print $1}' | tr -d '\r')"
  csrf_token="$(echo "${resp}" | grep -i 'x-csrf-token: ' | awk '{print $2}')"
}

get() {
  resp="$(curl -k -X GET "${base_url}${1}" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -H "Cookie: TOKEN=${token}" \
    -H "x-csrf-token: ${csrf_token}")"

  echo "${resp}"
}

post() {
  resp="$(curl -k -X POST "${base_url}${1}" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -H "Cookie: TOKEN=${token}" \
    -H "x-csrf-token: ${csrf_token}" \
    -d "${2}")"

  echo "${resp}"
}

put() {
  resp="$(curl -k -X PUT "${base_url}${1}" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -H "Cookie: TOKEN=${token}" \
    -H "x-csrf-token: ${csrf_token}" \
    -d "${2}")"

  echo "${resp}"
}

echo "[INFO ] Installing JQ..."
dnf install -y jq

echo "[INFO ] Logging into UniFi"
login || fatal "Failed to log in"
echo "[INFO ] Uploading new certificate"
id=$(post /api/userCertificates '{"name":"le-'"${date}"'","cert":"'"${cert_pem}"'","key":"'"${key_pem}"'"}' | jq -r .id)
echo "[INFO ] Activating certificate"
put "/api/userCertificates/${id}/status" '{"active":true}' || fatal "Failed to activate new certificate"
echo "[INFO ] Complete"

defaults

account relay
host smtp-relay
from pds@hayden.moe

#!/bin/sh
OCC="php /var/www/html/occ"
$OCC app:enable files_external || true

mid() {
  php -r '$n=$argv[1];$j=json_decode(stream_get_contents(STDIN),true);if(is_array($j))foreach($j as $m){if(isset($m["mount_point"])&&strpos($m["mount_point"],$n)!==false){echo $m["mount_id"];break;}}' "$1" 2>/dev/null
}

ensure() {
  NAME="$1"; DIR="$2"
  if ! $OCC files_external:list --all --output=json 2>/dev/null | grep -q "$DIR"; then
    $OCC files_external:create "$NAME" local null::null -c datadir="$DIR" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  ID=$($OCC files_external:list --all --output=json 2>/dev/null | mid "$NAME")
  if [ -n "$ID" ]; then
    $OCC files_external:option "$ID" readonly true >/dev/null 2>&1
    $OCC files_external:option "$ID" enable_sharing true >/dev/null 2>&1
    echo "ensured external mount '$NAME' (id=$ID) -> $DIR"
  else
    echo "WARN: '$NAME' present/created but could not read id to set options"
  fi
}

ensure "Tailey (private)" /family-data/tailey
ensure "Family recovery"  /family-data/family
exit 0

for table in /proc/net/udp /proc/net/udp6; do

  done < "$table"
done
